480:t_000:37.en:
$$ランド$$
「...No... We went through a lot, but in the end we were enemies.」

480:t_000:38.en:
$$ランド$$
「Outrageous doesn't begin to cover it, but the way that person was so honest about their desires... It was human. I didn't hate it...」

480:t_000:39.en:
$$メール$$
「Does that mean you don't hate $$エルーナルーナ$$ either!?」

480:t_001:0.en:
$$正太郎$$
「The main force is the $$ハイアデス$$!」

480:t_001:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「But neither $$エルーナルーナ$$ nor $$ダバラーン$$ is here! What luck!」

480:t_001:3.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「It is unnatural for their commanders not to be here.」

480:t_001:4.en:
$$万丈$$
「Right... They're most likely holding back in the rear, waiting for an opening.」

480:t_001:5.en:
$$葵$$
「Then let's flush them out right away.」

480:t_002:0.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「You're getting too far out in front, $$葵$$!」

480:t_002:1.en:
$$葵$$
「Sorry... I just can't hold myself back.」

480:t_002:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「Fine by me, $$葵$$. I'll stick with you all the way.」

480:t_002:4.en:
$$葵$$
「Thanks, $$ランド$$. Picking you as my partner was the right call.」

480:t_002:5.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Well... Sending orders would be pointless.」

480:t_002:6.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「$$葵$$ must be sensing it instinctively. The enemy's presence...」

480:t_002:7.en:
$$竜馬$$
「If it's come to this, we've got no choice but to fight!」

480:t_002:8.en:
$$シモン$$
「Target the $$ハイアデス$$ warship! Take that down, and their boss will show up too!」

480:t_002:9.en:
$$葵$$
「Here we go, $$ハイアデス$$! I'm making you take the full heat of my boiling blood!」

480:t_004:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「So you showed up, $$エルーナルーナ$$!」

480:t_004:1.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Sorry to keep you waiting, Darling!」

480:t_004:3.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Sorry. It's not you I came to see today, Darling.」

480:t_004:5.en:
$$シリウス$$
「That sheer nerve is worthy of being called a dull ox!」

480:t_004:7.en:
$$葵$$
「It's me, isn't it, $$エルーナルーナ$$!」

480:t_005:0.en:
$$葵$$
「I'm honored. Getting picked personally by the Supreme Commander of the $$新地球皇国$$, no less.」

480:t_005:1.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「You bet. ...Don't you think we're kind of alike?」

480:t_005:3.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「This is no time to be agreeing!」

480:t_005:5.en:
$$葵$$
「If our characters overlap, all the more reason! I'm taking her down right here!」

480:t_007:3.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「HA! You underestimated the horns on $$プレイアデス・タウラ$$!」

480:t_007:4.en:
$$ランド$$
「$$葵$$'s fang got snapped off by that horn!」

480:t_007:5.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Now it's my turn!」

480:t_008:4.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「The $$断空剣$$ is the mental energy of the $$チームＤ$$ members made real...」

480:t_008:5.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「If it broke, then their minds must have taken major damage as well.」

480:t_008:7.en:
$$ランド$$
「If mental energy is what forms the blade, then just make a new one!」

480:t_008:8.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「It's no use, Darling. Those kids' wild instincts are already dead.」

480:t_008:10.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Beasts either kill or get killed. So the contest is decided in an instant.」

480:t_008:11.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「And defeat means death... Those kids lost to me, and their spirits died completely.」

480:t_008:12.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「In other words, they're just beaten dogs.」

480:t_008:14.en:
$$正太郎$$
「It's a lie! There's no way I can believe that!」

480:t_008:22.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「For a wild animal, defeat means death... What $$エルーナルーナ$$ says is correct.」

480:t_008:23.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「If we pull them back here, they will stay dead forever.」

480:t_009:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「For now, I'll handle this place until $$葵$$ and the others wake up!」

480:t_009:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「Everyone! I'll protect $$葵$$ and the others here! Until then, I'm counting on you to take on $$エルーナルーナ$$!」

480:t_009:3.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Aww... So Darling's on babysitting duty for that kid.」

480:t_009:4.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Fine. Once I've taken care of the rest of you, we'll have plenty of fun, okay?」
